A [[Lump of Charcoal]] is a rare crafting material.  It is used in the crafting of other rare crafting materials, including [[Steel Ingot]]s and [[Deldrimor Steel Ingot]]s.  

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
* Select [[artisan]]s will craft one Lump of Charcoal for 10 [[Wood Plank]]s and 200 {{gold}}.
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
** [[Deldrimor Steel Ingot]]
** [[Steel Ingot]]
** See [[:Category:Contains charcoal]] for other items.
* For known creatures that [[drop]] Lumps of Charcoal see [[:Category:Drops charcoal]].

==Crafting==
*Armor
**[[Stone Gauntlets]]

*Rare crafting materials
**[[Deldrimor Steel Ingot]]
**[[Steel Ingot]]

==Trivia==
*Can be acquired by opening a Grenth's [[Winter Gift]] from [[Wintersday 2005]].
